title: Digital love confession page · Proposigo
desc: Build a surprise page to confess to your crush: story, photos, music, and a “No” button that runs away. Ready in 5 minutes.
text: CONFESSION DIGITAL LOVE CONFESSION PAGE Build a surprise page to confess to your crush: story, photos, music, and a “No” button that runs away. Ready in 5 minutes. CREATE A CONFESS PAGE GO AHEAD, IT'S PLAYABLE 👇 SOMETHING FOR… DINDA (tap the envelope) CANDY PINK NIGHT CHAT ↺ RESTART WHAT RAKA GETS SENDER Play the sample page. Everything Dinda does shows up here, exactly like what you'll receive. PLAY TOGETHER GAMES YOU MAKE, THEY PLAY You write the content of these four games: your questions, your photos, your plans. Try them all below and see what comes back to you. HOW WELL DO YOU KNOW ME You write questions about yourself, they answer. The score is sent to you. TWO TRUTHS, ONE LIE Write three things about you two. One is a lie, they have to find it. PHOTO PUZZLE One of your photos is shuffled into 9 pieces. They put it back together. PLAN TOGETHER Offer a few plans. Their pick becomes a promise ticket, and you're notified. HOW WELL DO YOU KNOW ME How well do you know Raka? · 1/2 The drink I always order? Iced tea Iced latte Matcha SENT TO RAKA Finish the game. The result goes to the sender's dashboard and email. TWO DESIGNS, ONE SURPRISE CANDY PINK Sweet, pink, heart racing NIGHT CHAT Casual chat-story style WHO'S IT FOR? HOW TO CONFESS TO YOUR CRUSH WITH A LINK → SAMPLE STORY Hi Dinda. I'm a little nervous, so I made this page. Ever since we first talked, my days got brighter. You laugh at things that aren't funny, and I love that. So... I have one question for you.
